Name: Pilk
Author: Corruleum
Description:
[size=4]Bringing pilk, the (in)famous combination of Pepsi and milk, to the valley. Because what Stardew really needs is a disgusting drink.[/size]

[b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b]
[size=4]Content Patcher, of course[/size][size=4]. (If you don't already have this, what are you doing?)[/size]

[size=5][b]"Features"[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Universal hate! No one likes this![/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Reduces energy when consumed![/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Actively makes milk worse![/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Actively makes Joja Cola worse![/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Barely worth anything![/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Recipe k[/size][size=4]nown by default[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]i18n support[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Config options[/b][/size]
[size=4]Pilk colour: Choose between brown pilk and blue pilk. Default brown.[/size]
[size=4]Jilk toggle: Rename pilk (Pepsi + milk) [/size][size=4]to jilk (Joja Cola + milk) [/size][size=4]for immersion. Default false.[/size]

[size=5][b]Permissions[/b][/size]
[size=4]Translations welcome, [b][u]as long as AI is NOT used[/u][/b] and my mod is required[/size]
[size=4]Do not feed any part of this into AI for any reason[/size]
